'''Enforcement''' was the military branch of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. Enforcement combined the duties of [[Justice (department)/Legends|Justice]] and [[Enforcement (Imperial Security Bureau)/Legends|Enforcement]]. The [[Pentastar Patrol]] was one of the largest Enforcement units.{{Company-stub}}
